csv_to_json.name: csv_to_json
csv_to_json.description: Convert a CSV file with a header row into a JSON file containing an array of objects (one per data row, keyed by header). Integer and decimal values (e.g. 42, -3, 4.50) are written as JSON numbers; everything else stays a string. Blank rows are skipped, short rows are padded with empty strings, and rows with more cells than headers cause an error. The delimiter is auto-detected from the header row (comma, semicolon, tab, pipe) unless specified. Input is read as UTF-8; the output file is written (overwritten) as indented UTF-8 JSON. Prints 'Wrote N rows to <output>' on success; exits non-zero with an error message if the input is missing/unreadable, the header is missing or has empty names, or the delimiter is invalid. Relative paths resolve against the tool's working (project) directory.
csv_to_json.approval_note: approved by the user in chat
